payload.body:
**ID:** MP-CGA-001 | **Priority:** P0 | **PRD refs:** FR7 | **Status:** draft
**Group:** MP Content Generation Agent (`mp-content-generation-agent`)

---

# Extend newsletter contract with provenance and token fields

## Summary

The `Newsletter` database model and `postContentGenerationBodySchema` API contract currently store only `subject`, `description`, `content`, and `tickerId`. This ticket extends the contract, Prisma schema, API handlers, and SDK client to accept and persist provenance and token-usage fields so that a subsequent agent ticket can write rich metadata on each successful generation.

## Scope

- In scope:
  - Add optional fields to `postContentGenerationBodySchema` in `packages/shared/agent-data-api-contract/src/content-generation.ts`: `model`, `agentVersion`, `configVersion`, `promptHash`, `configSnapshotId`, `promptTokens`, `completionTokens`, `totalTokens`.
  - Extend the `Newsletter` Prisma model in `packages/mediapulse/database/prisma/schema.prisma` with matching nullable columns; generate and commit the migration using `pnpm --filter @mediapulse/database db:migrate:dev`.
  - Update `apps/mediapulse/agent-data-api` route handler and service to accept and persist the new fields.
  - Update `@workspace/agent-data-api-client` response parsing / POST method to include the new fields.
  - Add/extend tests: route/service (with and without provenance fields), SDK call shape.
  - Update `dev-docs/docs/mediapulse/apps/agent-data-api.mdx` to document the new newsletter POST fields.
- Out of scope:
  - The agent-side wiring that actually supplies these values at runtime (covered by MP-CGA-008).
  - Any UI changes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `postContentGenerationBodySchema` accepts all seven new fields as optional (no breaking change to existing callers that omit them).
- [ ] `Newsletter` Prisma model has nullable columns: `model`, `agentVersion`, `configVersion`, `promptHash`, `configSnapshotId`, `promptTokens`, `completionTokens`, `totalTokens`.
- [ ] A Prisma migration file is generated and committed; `db:migrate:dev` applies cleanly.
- [ ] API handler stores the new fields when provided; existing payloads without the new fields continue to work (nullable/missing → `null` in DB).
- [ ] `@workspace/agent-data-api-client` POST method types include the new optional fields.
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover: POST with all provenance fields, POST without provenance fields (backward-compatible), Prisma service layer writing nullable values.
- [ ] `pnpm code-quality` passes with no new errors.
- [ ] `dev-docs` newsletter POST section updated to document new optional fields.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none
- Blocks: MP-CGA-008

## Stacked delivery

This ticket ships an **additive, backward-compatible** schema and contract change. All new fields are optional/nullable, so existing newsletter create calls (e.g. from the current agent) continue to work without modification. No feature flag is required — the new columns exist in the DB but remain `null` until MP-CGA-008 populates them.

**Merge order:** Ship this ticket to `main` before MP-CGA-008. MP-CGA-008 branches from this ticket's branch (or from `main` after this merges).

## Notes

- Follow the `agent-data-api-endpoints` skill checklist: update contract → manifest (if applicable) → server handlers → SDK → tests → docs.
- Follow `prisma-migrate-dev` skill: edit `schema.prisma` only, then run `db:migrate:dev` to generate the SQL; do not hand-write migration files.
- Field naming convention: `camelCase` in TypeScript schemas; Prisma will map to `snake_case` in the DB by default (or use `@map` if project convention differs — check existing `Newsletter` fields for the project pattern).
- `promptHash`: a short hash (e.g. SHA-256 first 16 hex chars) of the effective system + user prompt after placeholder substitution. The hashing logic will live in the agent (MP-CGA-008); this ticket only adds the storage field.
- `configSnapshotId`: an immutable reference to the Hermes config snapshot that produced this generation. Exact semantics (Hermes snapshot UUID vs hash of full config JSON) to be confirmed during MP-CGA-003 / MP-CGA-008 implementation; this ticket stores it as a nullable string.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/content-generation-agent-prd.md
